headline: Executive order creates a new White House office focused on special peace missions.
what_it_does: This executive order sets up a new office inside the White House for what it calls special peace missions. No summary was provided, so details such as the office's exact duties, staff, and budget are not known from the available information.

who_it_affects.how: A new office is created within the White House to handle peace-related missions.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed June 30, 2025; exact effective date not stated in the available information.
